name: Jitsi Meet
tagline: Open source Zoom alternative. Encrypted video conferencing, no account needed.
shortDescription: Jitsi Meet is a fully encrypted, open source video conferencing platform. No account needed, share a link, start a meeting. The open source Zoom.
longDescription:
## What it is

Jitsi Meet is an open source video conferencing platform. WebRTC-based, end-to-end encrypted, no account or install required — share a link, join a meeting. Self-hostable, with a free public instance at meet.jit.si.

## Why we recommend it

The cleanest open source Zoom alternative. The public instance at meet.jit.si is free for everyone, and the codebase is straightforward to self-host for organizations that need it on their own infrastructure.

## When to use it

- Free video conferencing with no account needed
- Self-hosted video for organizations with privacy requirements
- Embedding video calls in your app (Jitsi IFrame API)
- Replacing Zoom for budget-conscious teams
installCommand: curl https://download.jitsi.org/jitsi-repo.gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/jitsi-keyring.gpg && sudo apt install jitsi-meet
installInstructions:
**Quick install (Ubuntu):**
```
curl https://download.jitsi.org/jitsi-repo.gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/jitsi-keyring.gpg
sudo apt install jitsi-meet
```

**Docker:** `docker-compose up -d` with the official compose file.

**Public instance:** Free at meet.jit.si (no signup).
pricingDetails: Free. Apache-2.0 licensed. Self-host or use meet.jit.si.
